questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how cancellation of the quote requests is handled? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Why is the outcomes channel buffered with len(d.providers)?
choices: So Assign can read results in the order the providers were listed
So provider goroutines that finish after Assign has returned can still send without blocking forever
So at most one provider is queried at a time
So ctx.Done() is never selected while results are pending

questions.prompt: Two of three providers return errors quickly, and the third answers with a valid quote 400 ms later. What does Assign return?
choices: The error from the first failing provider, since it arrived first
A joined error listing both failures, because errors are collected before the third answer is read
The third provider's quote, after logging the two failures as warnings
context.DeadlineExceeded, because the failures consumed part of the deadline

questions.prompt: The dispatch deadline is 2 seconds and every provider takes 10 seconds to respond. What does the caller of Assign observe?
choices: After 2 seconds an error that wraps context.DeadlineExceeded, so errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) is true
After 10 seconds the first provider's quote, since Assign waits for results
After 2 seconds a joined error of every provider's timeout failure
An immediate panic because the channel is closed while goroutines are sending
